name: Sierra Sur de Jaén
terms: Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: An Andalusian vino de la tierra in the southwest of Jaén province, covering municipalities such as Alcalá la Real, Alcaudete and Martos.
